title: sprint-init's required permissions baseline forces pre-approval of git push, curl and docker
detail: permissions.RECOMMENDED_ALLOW is both the template allow list and what sprint-init hard-requires (gate.py step 6). It includes Bash(git push *), Bash(curl *), Bash(docker *), Bash(docker-compose *). No sprint role needs them: integrator.md makes push opt-in and user-authorized, and building/solo phases deny git push. A project that removes them to keep pushes operator-gated cannot start a sprint (engine repo, 2026-11-15: settings.local.json trimmed to 5 entries, sprint-init rc=1 with 59 missing). Fix: outward-facing entries become opt-in, out of the required set and the shipped template.
